blocks.PHOTO: Cinematic photoreal film still, overcast diffuse light, muted desaturated colour, 35mm lens. No captions, no watermark, no border.
blocks.ARCHIVAL: Authentic black and white press photograph of the period, grainy, high contrast.
blocks.ISOLATE: Isolated on a plain pure white background, nothing else in the image.
blocks.ISOLATE_BLACK: Pure black background, nothing else in the image.

example_plate.prompt: Describe the whole scene: subject, place, era, time of day, what the camera sees. $PHOTO

example_cutout.prompt: One object that will pass close to the lens, full height of the frame. $ISOLATE
